scene_guidance: Pick the scene whose world matches the brief (pagoda_mountain for epic/mythic scale, ancient_hall for ritual/dialogue in a temple courtyard, mist_forest for eerie intimacy, warehouse for modern/neutral). You may change scene_id between segments when the story moves location, but hold each scene for at least two consecutive segments.

shot_spec_schema.pose_id: one of poses[] (procedural) — or use pose_action + pose_frame for action poses
shot_spec_schema.character_rotation: degrees, optional; extra turn on top of the anchor facing

warehouse.label: 空旷混凝土仓库
warehouse.description: Bare concrete warehouse, raking side light from frame-left, one cube prop at frame-right. Neutral, cinematic, works for drama, dance, action and monologue.

cameras.cam_wide: Full body, very small in frame (~25% of height) with lots of room; establishing shot, shows the cube prop. NOTE: the restyle pass tends to enlarge small subjects, so prefer cam_medium unless the story needs emptiness.
cameras.cam_medium: Full body, tighter; default for action and gesture.
cameras.cam_close: Waist-up; emotion and face-adjacent beats. Only use with anchor_center.
cameras.cam_low: Low angle full body; heroic or ominous.

anchors.anchor_center: Centre of the room, facing camera.
anchors.anchor_left: Frame-left (about 0.85m left of centre), angled 15 degrees toward centre. Safe in all cameras except cam_close.
anchors.anchor_right: Frame-right (about 0.85m right of centre), angled 15 degrees toward centre. Safe in all cameras except cam_close.
anchors.anchor_near_prop: Standing right beside the cube prop, angled toward it.

pagoda_mountain.label: 云山古塔
pagoda_mountain.description: Mountain crest at dusk directly below a colossal multi-storey Chinese pagoda: carved balustrades, bracketed eaves and lattice windows tower over the character; craggy rock and grass underfoot, misty ridges and a low sun behind. Eastern mythology / wuxia / dark epic; the strongest 'world-scale' scene in the library. Source: Blender demo 'Temple' by Dominik Graf (CC-BY), adapted.

cameras.cam_wide: Full body small on the rocky crest; the pagoda's balustrade and eaves fill the upper frame. Establishing / awe.
cameras.cam_medium: Full body, tighter; the carved railing and bracket sets loom right behind. Default for gestures and vows.
cameras.cam_low: Low angle looking up past the character into the pagoda eaves; heroic, oppressive.

anchors.anchor_center: On the level crest, facing camera, pagoda centred behind.
anchors.anchor_left: Frame-left on the crest, angled toward centre.

ancient_hall.label: 古殿回廊
ancient_hall.description: Stone cloister courtyard of an ancient monastery: two storeys of round-arched arcades on slender columns, tiled roofs, a well, tall grass between flagstones, soft overcast sky. Reads as a temple / palace courtyard once restyled; good for dialogue, ritual, stillness, arrivals. Source: Blender demo 'Lone Monk' by Carlo Bergonzini (CC-BY), adapted.

cameras.cam_wide: Full body small in the courtyard, the whole two-storey arcade behind. Establishing.
cameras.cam_medium: Full body in front of the arcade arches. Default for gesture and movement.
cameras.cam_close: Waist-up, columns and arch framing the head. Only with anchor_center.
cameras.cam_low: Low angle, arcade and roofline rising above the character.

anchors.anchor_center: Courtyard centre-line on the flagstones, facing camera.

mist_forest.label: 雾林枯木
mist_forest.description: A small clearing in cold night mist with one huge gnarled bare tree whose branches spread over the whole frame; soft ground, drifting embers, deep blue haze beyond. Intimate, eerie, spirit-forest / ghost-story mood; the world ends in mist a few metres away, so it feels enclosed. Source: Blender demo 'Ember Forest' by Mike Pan (CC-BY), adapted.

cameras.cam_wide: Full body under the whole tree, branches crowning the frame. Establishing / solitude.
cameras.cam_medium: Full body in front of the trunk, canopy above. Default.
cameras.cam_close: Waist-up against the trunk and branches. Only with anchor_center.
cameras.cam_low: Low angle up through the branches; ominous.

anchors.anchor_center: Just in front of the trunk, facing camera.
anchors.anchor_left: Frame-left of the trunk, angled toward centre.
anchors.anchor_right: Frame-right of the trunk, angled toward centre.
anchors.anchor_near_prop: Right at the base of the trunk, angled toward it.

idle_neutral.label: 自然站立
idle_neutral.description: Relaxed standing, arms hanging by the sides, weight even, looking forward.

arm_up_point.label: 一臂高举，一臂前指
arm_up_point.description: Left arm raised straight up, right arm extended straight forward toward camera at shoulder height; wide stance with the left leg forward and bent. Dynamic, declarative.

arms_crossed.label: 双臂交叉
arms_crossed.description: Standing with arms folded across the chest, slight head tilt. Guarded, thoughtful.

walk_stride.label: 行走跨步
walk_stride.description: Mid-stride walk toward camera: right leg forward, left leg back, opposite arm swing. Purposeful movement.

sit_ground.label: 席地而坐
sit_ground.description: Sitting on the floor with knees bent up, forearms resting on the knees. Reflective, low energy.

reach_forward.label: 双手向前伸
reach_forward.description: Both arms reaching forward toward the camera at chest height, slight lean in. Inviting or grasping.

look_back_turn.label: 回头看
look_back_turn.description: Body turned three-quarters away from camera, head turned back toward the camera over the shoulder. Cinematic reveal. Uses character_rotation in the shot spec for the body turn.

crouch_ready.label: 半蹲预备
crouch_ready.description: Athletic half-crouch, knees bent, arms slightly forward and out for balance. Tension before action.
